provenance.difference: New teaching boundary: Drifting arms. Existing boundary: The learner can explain that a picking history (links change, colours fixed) and a copying history (colours change, links fixed) can end in the identical picture, so one snapshot cannot separate selection from influence, and that telling them apart needs data over time.
